categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacture and sale of large marine engines, including low- and medium-speed engines for ship propulsion and auxiliary power, as well as environmental pollution control facilities (SCR). It also engages in parts sales and services for marine engines and diesel power generation business supplying diesel engines for power plants and emergency generators for nuclear power plants. The SCR business focuses on designing, manufacturing, and installing selective catalytic reduction systems to meet IMO Tier III environmental regulations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced engine design and manufacturing technologies, including proprietary low-temperature SCR systems (DelNOx) for emission reduction. It has developed world-first dual-fuel (DF) marine engines and compact SCR models, employing technologies such as AR/VR for training, machine learning for fault diagnosis, and laser cladding for coating and remanufacturing. Production involves assembly plants specialized for dual-fuel engines and extensive R&D in performance, materials, mechatronics, and control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international shipbuilders such as Samsung Heavy Industries and Hanwha Ocean, as well as overseas shipyards in China. The company serves the global marine propulsion market, diesel power generation projects in emerging countries and island regions, and nuclear power plants requiring emergency generators. Its products are sold primarily to shipbuilders, shipping companies, power utilities, and industrial clients requiring diesel power solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in South Korea, China, and other international markets. It has a global supply and sales network for parts and services and engages in export sales constituting over 90% of total revenue. Its operations and customer base span Asia, Europe, and emerging markets where marine and power generation industries are active.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier in the marine engine and diesel power generation supply chain. It produces engines and environmental control systems under license agreements with technology licensors and supplies directly to shipbuilders and power project developers. It also provides aftermarket parts and services, positioning itself as an integrated engine maker and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing environmentally friendly, high-efficiency engines and emission control technologies to comply with increasingly stringent international regulations. R&D focuses on dual-fuel engines, SCR systems, smart engine diagnostics, and digital solutions such as remote control and monitoring. The company invests in compact SCR designs, ammonia fuel technologies, and advanced catalyst systems, aiming to expand its market share in eco-friendly marine propulsion and power generation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of marine engines and SCR systems, accounting for approximately 85.6% of sales, with the remainder from diesel power generation, parts sales, and rental services. The company secures contracts through direct sales to shipbuilders and utilities, often involving staged payments (advance, progress, and final payments). It also earns licensing fees under technology agreements and provides aftermarket parts and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the second-largest global market share in low-speed marine engines, competing with major licensors such as MAN Energy Solutions and WinGD. Domestically, it competes with HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and STX Engine. In diesel power generation, it competes with global suppliers and local partners, leveraging its engineering and production capabilities. The company emphasizes cost competitiveness and technological innovation to maintain and expand its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 854.4 billion KRW, with an operating profit of 8.7 billion KRW, marking a return to profitability after previous losses. Total assets stood at about 1.14 trillion KRW, with equity of 224.1 billion KRW and a debt ratio of 407.19%. The company has shown revenue growth of 11.79% year-over-year and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced dual-fuel engine technology, proprietary low-temperature SCR emission control systems, and comprehensive after-sales service networks. It offers integrated solutions that meet stringent environmental regulations and customer-specific requirements, enhancing fuel efficiency and reducing emissions. Its strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver innovative, eco-friendly marine propulsion and power generation products that address evolving market demands.
